stem.text: The graph below shows the variation of the first ionisation energy with proton number for some elements. The letters used are not the usual symbols for the elements.

stem.alt: Graph of first ionisation energy (kJ mol-1) against proton number for elements labelled P to X; peaks at P and X, with sharp drops at Q and at the point after X.

stem.text: Which statement about the elements is correct?

A.text: P and X are in the same period in the Periodic Table.

B.text: The general increase from Q to X is due to increasing atomic radius.

C.text: The small decrease from R to S is due to decreased shielding.

D.text: The small decrease from U to V is due to repulsion between paired electrons.
